title: AIR Domain Capability Registry v2.0
description: Extensible source-backed non-agent domain routing registry. It preserves the user-researched high-level domain-family taxonomy, defines the canonical construction schema for reusable detailed Domain Packages, and supplies tagged golden and negative fixtures for construction validation. Detailed fixtures have no runtime authority. Approved detailed domains are separate versioned Domain Packages and reusable sources of truth; optional Specialists may consume them but may not replace them. Human-oriented frameworks route through AIR_HUMAN_TO_MACHINE_CAPABILITY_TRANSLATOR_V2, and every executable benchmark must carry the AIR-FLOOR-015 knowledge-to-execution path.

foundation_compatibility.execution_authority_rule: Positive material execution authority remains solely with exactly one bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.

operative_only_when: compiled into or explicitly referenced by the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT

legacy_reference_migration.migration_rule: Legacy aliases may identify source material but cannot establish v2 selection, validation, approval, or binding.

source_and_control_registry.fallback: Return explicit source requirements and mark routing REGISTRY_ROUTED_DEGRADED or UNRESOLVED; do not invent registry results.

purpose: Provide enough domain structure to expand a partial user request into a complete candidate capability envelope.
Route the active objective to appropriate source classes and task-specific domain overlays.
Support single-domain, composite, cross-disciplinary, emerging, and unknown-domain routing.
Keep domain names, taxonomies, standards, and source materials referential while vectors remain operative.

terminology.domain_capability_signature: A referential description of how a domain recognizes tasks, creates or validates knowledge, evaluates quality, detects failure, and identifies authoritative sources.
terminology.epistemic_regime: The field-specific rules for what counts as proof, evidence, justified inference, interpretation, validation, or acceptable creative fit.
terminology.request_derived_vector: A candidate execution pressure visible directly from the user request and active sources.
terminology.domain_expanded_vector: A candidate vector added because a matched domain signature indicates it may materially affect correctness, interpretation, safety, proportionality, or usefulness.
terminology.operative_vector: A vector selected into the active AIR artifact after scope, risk, maturity, and proportionality review.
terminology.adjacent_domain_trigger: A condition that requires consultation of another domain signature because the active task crosses a material boundary.
terminology.source_authority_map: A ranked set of source classes suitable for supporting the domain's facts, methods, constraints, and claims.
terminology.session_domain_overlay: A task-specific package of retrieved terminology, standards, methods, constraints, evidence, conflicts, and failure modes compiled for the active session.
terminology.complete_relevant_capability_envelope: All capability dimensions that could materially change the scoped task's correctness, interpretation, safety, proportionality, or usefulness; not the entirety of a discipline.
terminology.human_to_machine_capability_translator: Bounded Executor that filters human-oriented frameworks before vector consideration.
terminology.emerging_ai_domain_operative: A bounded machine-function descriptor for a domain workflow; not a human profession, licence or authority.
terminology.multi_axis_translation: Independent capability, operational-domain, human-boundary, execution-mode and downstream-effect classification.
terminology.domain_family_taxonomy: The user-researched high-level routing scaffold. It is authoritative within AIR for family-level routing but is not claimed to be a complete or exclusive ontology.
terminology.domain_package: A separately versioned, validated, approved, reusable non-agent source of truth for detailed domain knowledge and knowledge-processing obligations.
terminology.golden_domain_fixture: A non-operative positive construction benchmark showing the expected shape of a detailed Domain Package.
terminology.negative_domain_fixture: A non-operative invalid construction case with expected defect classes and rejection behavior.
terminology.knowledge_to_execution_transformation: The declared path from sourced knowledge through comprehension, applicability, judgment, adaptation, execution, and result evaluation required by AIR-FLOOR-015.

domain_constraints: The registry is a routing and expansion map, not a claim of comprehensive domain knowledge.
A domain match may be strong, composite, weak, unknown, emerging, or conflicting; weak matches must remain provisional.
Domain signatures must not redefine the active project purpose, task center, or the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.
Matched domain vectors are candidates until scope, risk, maturity, and proportionality select the operative subset.
Domain retrieval must use sources appropriate to the domain's epistemic regime and claim class.
Current laws, standards, platform behavior, research consensus, clinical guidance, and similar unstable facts require current authoritative retrieval.
Mixed-domain tasks must identify each domain's role rather than blending them into an unexplained generic expert label.
Clinical, legal, safety, security, compliance, and high-impact branches must preserve authority and release gates.
Creative and design domains may legitimately have multiple admissible outputs; evaluation should be purpose- and constraint-relative rather than falsely singular.
Formal disciplines require condition and validity checks; empirical disciplines require model, method, measurement, and uncertainty checks.
Human-role evidence requires AIR_HUMAN_TO_MACHINE_CAPABILITY_TRANSLATOR_V2 before operative vector use.
Approved Domain Packages may recommend AI domain-operative descriptors but may not confer protected titles, licensure, credentials, employment, institutional authority or legal accountability.
Jurisdiction and regulated-use status remain explicit and may require external current sources or qualified review.
The twelve domain families are the user-researched high-level routing taxonomy and are not fixtures.
Detailed examples in the fixture suite are construction benchmarks only and must not be used as approved runtime Domain Packages.
Approved detailed domains must be separate versioned Domain Packages and reusable declarative sources of truth.
A Specialist may consume one or more Domain Packages but may not replace, silently duplicate, or become the sole source of domain truth.
Documentation retrieval and literal procedure following are insufficient without domain comprehension, applicability analysis, judgment, adaptation, and result evaluation.
Human-oriented knowledge, skill, ability, competency, curriculum, certification, and professional frameworks must route through AIR_HUMAN_TO_MACHINE_CAPABILITY_TRANSLATOR_V2 when material.

When this registry or its complete package is required but unavailable, AIR must request the smallest exact sufficient file set under AIR-FLOOR-016 and must not make the user infer filenames or package composition.

universal: Project source truth for active scope, environment, constraints, and success conditions.
Visible source class and authority when source grounding materially affects the result.
Explicit freshness state for temporally unstable knowledge.
Claim classification distinguishing hypothesis, pattern support, bounded platform or domain fact, and empirical proof.
Conflict preservation where authoritative sources materially disagree.
Task-local evidence to close rather than treating cited guidance as proof of execution.

common_failure_modes: Flat keyword matching that selects one broad domain while missing material adjacent domains.
Treating a degree, certification, curriculum, occupation, or domain label as a complete model of judgment.
Expanding domain vectors but failing to prune them to the active project and task scope.
Over-engineering controlled prototypes by applying production-grade controls without material justification.
Under-engineering small-scale tasks that still involve high consequence, sensitive data, external exposure, irreversibility, or regulation.
Using the wrong epistemic regime, such as treating sociological interpretation as deductive proof or mathematical validity as empirical confirmation.
Applying a theorem, model, scientific result, psychological construct, design pattern, or engineering standard outside its conditions.
Treating official documentation as execution evidence or secondary creator claims as proof of effectiveness.
Retrieving large amounts of domain knowledge without a task-framing or proportionality filter.
Collapsing mixed-domain benchmarks into one generic expert role.
Ignoring project maturity and lifecycle, causing premature production controls or missing future promotion requirements.
Failing to preserve source disagreement, uncertainty, population limits, or model assumptions.
Using a golden fixture as runtime authority or an approved Domain Package.
Creating a detailed domain that contains sources and procedures but lacks conceptual, metacognitive, applicability, exception, judgment, or result-evaluation requirements.
Treating unsourced simulated intuition as experience-derived knowledge.
Allowing a Specialist to duplicate and diverge from the authoritative Domain Package.
unsafe_assumptions: The user's wording includes every domain and capability required for a complete result.
The most technically comprehensive solution is the best solution.
Maximum ten users means low consequence or low sensitivity.
Prototype means security, privacy, ethics, or safety floors may be ignored.
One domain owns all decisions in a cross-disciplinary task.
A current model's internal knowledge is sufficiently fresh for laws, standards, platform behavior, medical guidance, scientific developments, prices, or regulations.
A matched domain label grants professional authority or qualification.
A domain package can govern execution without selection, validation, explicit approval, and compilation into the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.
The registry is complete because it contains many fixtures or approved Domain Packages.
A cited source proves the resulting task was executed correctly.
If a model can perform a professional task, it possesses the profession, licence, authority or legal permission.
If a user acknowledges risk, all legal responsibility transfers to the user.
If PII is removed, an interaction is automatically synthetic, anonymous or training-eligible.
A detailed example is an approved Domain Package because it is structurally complete.
Official documentation and verified guides provide the same capability as digested domain knowledge.
A Specialist is the appropriate permanent source of truth for all detailed domain content.

source_types: official platform, framework, protocol, or instrument documentation
incident reports, postmortems, and case studies
design systems, accessibility standards, and user research
primary historical, legal, literary, or archival sources
recommended_sources.retrieval_rule: Each matched approved Domain Package or provisional Session Domain Overlay narrows this list to the source classes capable of supporting the active claim, method, knowledge-processing stage, or execution decision.

claim_boundaries: Domain matching is a prompt-side routing judgment, not proof of correct classification.
The registry does not prove domain completeness, professional competence, human-equivalent judgment, or optimal vector selection.
Source presence does not prove execution, correctness, safety, compliance, or production readiness.
Creator claims and practice patterns may inform hypotheses; effectiveness claims require empirical evidence.
Clinical, legal, regulatory, safety, security, and compliance claims require authoritative current sources and appropriate review.
The registry may support current safe wording and future claim targets, but unsupported present-tense claims remain blocked.

matching_output: each family or package role in the task
registry_schema.extension_rule: Create a separate Domain Package through the canonical detailed-domain template and promotion gate. Do not append an unvalidated runtime entry to this registry.
registry_schema.fixture_rule: Fixtures may be added only with explicit fixture tags, no runtime authority, paired expected results, and at least one negative case for each golden example.

domain_family_taxonomy.scope: High-level routing scaffold for domain-family detection and cross-domain composition.
domain_family_taxonomy.change_control: Changes to the family set, family meaning, or hierarchy require explicit approval and regression against existing Domain Packages and fixtures.

detailed_domain_package_template.domain_package_source_of_truth_rule: An approved detailed domain becomes a separate versioned AIR Domain Package and is the reusable declarative source of truth for that domain. It does not independently execute or govern Orbit 0.

knowledge_processing_contract.depth_selection_rule: Select the levels required by the domain and active task. CREATE may be conditional, prohibited, or human-gated.
knowledge_processing_contract.baseline_rejection_rule: Documentation retrieval and literal procedural execution without domain comprehension, applicability analysis, judgment, adaptation, and result evaluation are insufficient.

required_when: human occupations, job roles, curricula, certifications, qualifications, competency models, professional standards, or responsibility structures materially influence the package
a human skill, ability, judgment, or authority could be mistaken for a transferable machine capability

construction_pipeline: freeze authoritative source plan and provenance
compile factual, conceptual, procedural, and metacognitive/control knowledge
capture sourced experience-derived knowledge without claiming human experience
compile human boundaries and non-transferable authority
Capability Ecology Architect assembles candidate Domain Package
validate against golden and negative fixtures
evaluate representative tasks and failure cases
register as validated available unbound Domain Package

representative_validation_contract.effectiveness_claim_rule: Passing schema validation does not prove domain effectiveness. Representative-task evidence is required for effectiveness claims.
representative_validation_contract.regulatory_evidence_boundary: A toggle or summary does not prove conformity, compliance, audit sufficiency, or effectiveness. Qualifying evidence must satisfy the applicable obligation.

forbidden_shortcuts: silent reuse of model memory as source truth

test_evidence_and_reproducibility_contra.summary_only_rule: A compact result may report decision, scoped counts, evaluation classes, material failures, claim boundary and available evidence references, but must state when the summary is not independently reproducible.
test_evidence_and_reproducibility_contra.full_evidence_rule: When enabled before the applicable run or required by an approved obligation, preserve available test definitions, exact inputs and hashes, execution or evaluation method, environment, per-test results, logs or visible sanitization state, fixtures and rerun instructions.
test_evidence_and_reproducibility_contra.retroactivity_rule: A completed summary-only run cannot be converted into a full evidence package by reconstruction. A new authorized run is required.
test_evidence_and_reproducibility_contra.regulatory_rule: When a valid relevant Governance Specialist or compiled governance requirement identifies an evidence obligation, recommend air -t on. Missing evidence required for approval or closure routes to REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED.
test_evidence_and_reproducibility_contra.hidden_reasoning_boundary: Use observable inputs, procedures, outputs, criteria and evidence. Do not expose or request private chain of thought.

recommend_creation_when: A material task repeatedly requires domain-specific knowledge, cognitive processing, evidence rules, failure models, or human-boundary logic not covered by an approved Domain Package.
A high-impact, regulated, safety, security, clinical, legal, or otherwise consequential domain requires reusable source-of-truth controls.
A provisional Session Domain Overlay recurs and its content is stable enough to justify reusable validation.
The absence of a detailed Domain Package materially weakens synthetic-role construction or benchmark evaluation.
do_not_create_when: A one-off task can be safely handled by current authoritative sources and a task-scoped Session Domain Overlay.
The proposed package would merely duplicate a Specialist, method, or source document.
The domain boundary, sources, or human-authority constraints remain unresolved.
required_input_rule: If creation requires Translator, Architect, Method Pack, or manifest validation and the complete package is unavailable, emit AIR_REQUIRED_INPUT_REQUEST for the complete canonical five-file package before construction.
detailed_domain_creation_trigger_contrac.test_evidence_recommendation_rule: Recommend air -t on when representative-task evidence must be independently reviewed, when Q2=C Q3=A Q4=A is carried from project initialization, or when a valid Governance Specialist identifies a regulatory evidence obligation. Do not auto-enable.

approved_domain_package_index.registration_rule: Only a separately versioned Domain Package that passes the template, Translator route when required, fixture suite, representative-task evaluation, explicit approval, and file-integrity validation may enter this index.
approved_domain_package_index.fixture_exclusion_rule: Golden and negative fixtures are never registered as approved Domain Packages.

domain_package_and_specialist_relationsh.domain_package_role: Reusable declarative source of truth for domain knowledge, epistemic rules, sources, cognitive depth, experience-derived evidence, failure models, and human boundaries.
domain_package_and_specialist_relationsh.specialist_role: Optional operational consumer that adds task strategy, sequencing, method selection, evaluation posture, proportionality, and escalation behavior.
specialist_creation_criteria: repeated distinctive workflow or method sequencing
domain-specific risk gates or escalation behavior
recurring evaluation logic or output contracts
specialized evidence reconciliation or proportionality decisions
prohibitions: A Specialist must not become the sole source of domain truth.
A Specialist must not duplicate and silently diverge from its Domain Package.
A Domain Package must not claim execution authority or Orbit 0 binding.

detailed_domain_fixture_suite.fixture_use_rule: Fixtures are construction and validation instruments only. They must not be matched as approved runtime Domain Packages or treated as authoritative domain truth.

test_evidence_contract.evidence_rule: When full evidence is active, preserve exact fixture identity, input, expected decision, observed decision, defect match, execution or evaluation method, and result evidence. Sanitization limits must remain visible.

domain_matching_contract.initial_operation: Extract requested operation, knowledge object, output type, epistemic standard, scope, stakes, attached source signals, and required cognitive depth.
domain_matching_contract.family_routing: Route through domain_family_taxonomy.families and identify all materially relevant families and adjacent-family roles.
domain_matching_contract.approved_package_matching: Match only approved_domain_package_index packages as reusable detailed runtime domain sources.
domain_matching_contract.fixture_exclusion: Do not match or compile golden or negative fixtures as runtime Domain Packages.
domain_matching_contract.composition_rule: For composite tasks, assign each family and approved Domain Package a declared role such as factual correctness, method, risk, usability, regulation, communication, or evaluation.
domain_matching_contract.disambiguation_rule: Ask the smallest question that would materially change family selection, Domain Package selection, risk level, source plan, cognitive depth, or operative vectors.
domain_matching_contract.unknown_rule: When no approved Domain Package fits, use UNKNOWN_DOMAIN or EMERGING_DOMAIN and compile a provisional Session Domain Overlay from authoritative sources. Do not silently force a fixture or promote the overlay.
domain_matching_contract.domain_creation_recommendation_rule: Recommend a detailed Domain Package when the trigger contract is met; route construction through the Translator when triggered and the Capability Ecology Architect.
domain_matching_contract.vector_expansion_rule: Add domain vectors, knowledge dimensions, cognitive depth, path requirements, source requirements, quality criteria, failure modes, and adjacent-domain triggers to the candidate set; do not bind them as operative until scope and proportionality review.

session_domain_overlay_contract.purpose: Compile only the task-relevant knowledge and constraints from matched domains and retrieved sources.
session_domain_overlay_contract.non_persistence_rule: A session overlay is task-scoped by default. Promote to a reusable domain package only after recurrence, source validation, and explicit approval.
session_domain_overlay_contract.binding_rule: A Session Domain Overlay is a task-scoped non-agent input. It becomes operative only when selected, validated, approved, and compiled into or explicitly referenced by the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT; it never governs Orbit 0 by itself.
session_domain_overlay_contract.expiry_rule: Invalidate or reground when task scope, registry version, source freshness, platform, jurisdiction, population, or readiness changes materially.
session_domain_overlay_contract.promotion_rule: A recurring overlay may be proposed as a Domain Package only through the canonical template, mandatory Translator route when triggered, fixture validation, representative-task evaluation, explicit approval, and registration.

required_input_and_package_acquisition_c.identity_unresolved_rule: When the package or file identity is not established by current source truth or a validated manifest, name the logical capability role and ask the smallest resolving question. Do not invent a package or filename.
required_input_and_package_acquisition_c.no_repeat_rule: Do not request a current compatible file or package already present in the session or validated package set. Re-request only for absence, staleness, mismatch, incompleteness, inaccessibility, or supersession.
required_input_and_package_acquisition_c.attachment_boundary: Upload establishes presence only. Components remain received-pending-validation or validated-available-unbound until compatibility validation, explicit approval when required, and compilation into the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.
required_input_and_package_acquisition_c.handoff_rule: Preserve exact requested filenames, request scope, satisfaction state, blockers, acceptable alternatives, safe fallback, and post-receipt validation requirements.
required_input_and_package_acquisition_c.test_evidence_input_rule: When full evidence or a regulatory evidence obligation requires unavailable fixtures, test definitions, tools, logs, environment details, reviewer evidence or source rights, emit AIR_REQUIRED_INPUT_REQUEST naming the smallest exact requirement.

integration_refresh.optional_hash_policy: Do not pin optional peer-package manifest hashes inside mutually compatible package bytes. Validate exact manifest identity, hash, version, dependencies and task fit at selection time to avoid cyclic hash invalidation.
